description: DockMon - Modern Docker container monitoring with auto-restart and alerts

summary.one_liner: DockMon is a self-hosted Docker container monitoring and management platform with real-time dashboards, auto-restart, multi-channel alerting, and an event audit trail.
summary.what_it_does: DockMon monitors containers across multiple local and remote Docker hosts, showing live CPU, memory, and network statistics on a drag-and-drop WebSocket dashboard. It can stream logs from several containers at once and records an event viewer audit trail with filtering and search. Per-container auto-restart with retry logic and HTTP/HTTPS health checks can restart containers on failure. Alerts can be sent through Discord, Slack, Telegram, Pushover, Gotify, and SMTP using customizable templates. The README also describes Docker Compose stack management, scheduled image updates, blackout windows, group-based RBAC, OIDC/SSO login, and API keys.
use_cases: monitor docker containers across several hosts
get alerts on Discord, Slack, or Telegram when containers fail
view live logs from multiple containers
deploy and manage docker compose stacks
single sign-on for a docker dashboard
how_to_run: See the Installation guide in the wiki (Docker, unRAID, Synology, QNAP)
notable: Lightweight Go agent for remote hosts that avoids exposing Docker ports, runs as a container or systemd service
Optional historical stats persistence up to 90 days, disabled by default for privacy
OIDC/SSO with group sync and optional user approval workflow
Mutual TLS for remote host connections
Stack import from running containers or host filesystems with layer-by-layer pull progress
caveats: Business Source License 1.1 restricts offering it as a SaaS or embedding it in a commercial product to third parties; converts to Apache 2.0 on 2027-01-01
Upgrading from v1 requires recreating alert rules and regenerating mTLS certificates
The README describes the project as developed with AI assistance (vibe coding)
